title: European Commission proposes EU Kids Act banning social media for under-13s
summary: The European Union is advancing its most comprehensive proposal yet to restrict children under 13 from accessing social media platforms.
takeaways: Children under 13 blocked from social media accounts entirely
Ages 13–15 permitted only through parent-controlled mini accounts with 1-hour/day screen time cap
Safe-by-design mandate bans infinite scroll, reward tricks, notifications during sleep hours
AI chatbots and companions default off; designed to prevent emotional dependency
Age verification via EU app that doesn't store identity or biometric data; requires Parliament and member state approval

title: China's spy chief flags Claude Mythos and GPT-5.5-Cyber as major cyber threat escalation
summary: Chen Yixin, China's Ministry of State Security chief, identified Anthropic's Claude Mythos and OpenAI's GPT-5.5-Cyber as signs of a "disruptive upgrade" in cyber capabilities accelerating vulnerability discovery and malware development. Writing September 15, 2026, in China's Cyberspace Administratio
takeaways: China MSS chief Chen Yixin flagged Claude Mythos and GPT-5.5-Cyber (Sept 15, 2026)
Warning: 'vulnerability industrialization, fully automated attack and defense, AI versus AI'
AI enables rapid vulnerability discovery, automated attack paths, complex hacking at lower cost
Anthropic documented Chinese-speaking group using Claude for autonomous vulnerability research
Chen listed disinformation, espionage, data leaks, algorithmic governance, military AI as major risks

title: CrowdSec source code stolen in May 2026 TanStack supply chain attack
summary: Cybersecurity firm CrowdSec confirmed that its source code was compromised in the TanStack supply chain attack from May 2026.
takeaways: May 11, 2026: 84 malicious TanStack npm packages deployed (CVE-2026-45321)
Stolen credentials: GitHub tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials from developer machines
May 22: Attacker copied ~170 CrowdSec private repositories using stolen token
CrowdSec removed account May 25 (three days after copy)
Leaked code surfaced September 16; disclosed September 18
Leaked 83 CrowdSec user emails and 51 potential investor names/emails from 2020
Code was approximately four months old at breach time
Also affected Mistral AI and OpenAI
